# daisugi
# <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="1000" alt="" />

## daisugi: not-so-well-known tree machines

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of daisugi is to curate novel tree & boosting algorithms for use in R. daisugi unifies machines that are 1) not on CRAN, 2) not directly available in R, 3) or well known. Hence, daisugi does not have XGBoost, lightGBM, or catboost support. Those can be found via their base repos or supported via bonsai in tidymodels.

## Installation

You can install the development version of daisugi from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("frankiethull/daisugi")
```

## A Classification Task

```{r example}
library(daisugi)
library(forested)
library(rsample)

splits <- rsample::initial_split(forested::forested)
training <- rsample::training(splits)
testing <- rsample::testing(splits)
```

### yggdrasil decision forests (YDF) 
YDF provides various methods such as boosters, decisions, forests. what is unique is the a oblique random split technique. daisugi provides the boosted method with yggdrasil.
